name: Broad jump and bounds
pattern: Horizontal jump: swing, dip and drive forward (or sideways) as far as you can, then stick a soft landing.
setup: Feet hip width behind a line, toes forward.
Clear, non-slip floor and space to land.

steps.text: Swing your arms back as you hinge and bend your knees.
Throw your arms forward and up and push hips, knees and ankles straight, out and up at a low angle.
Bring your knees forward and your feet out in front of you.
Land on both feet, sink into a quarter squat, chest over your knees, and hold.

cues.why: Free arm motion added about 40 cm to a 1.6 m simulated standing long jump.
The best take-off angle is lower (about 20-27°) than the 31-39° people choose by instinct.

cues.cue: Stick it: soft knees, hips back, chest forward.
cues.why: Bent knees and hips at landing cut impact; falling back loses distance.
Knees caving in on landing link to knee ligament injury risk.

breathing: Breathe in on the swing, out as you jump.

tempo.note: Max effort jump, stick the landing for 1-2 seconds, walk back. Bounds and frog hops link jumps without a pause.

mistakes.name: Stiff landing
mistakes.looks: Legs nearly straight on contact; a loud slap.
mistakes.fix: Reach your feet forward and sink into a quarter squat.
mistakes.why: Raises impact force on the knees.

mistakes.name: Knees cave in
mistakes.looks: Knees fall inward as you land, often more on one side.
mistakes.fix: Shorter jumps; land with knees over your toes.
mistakes.why: Knee valgus on landing predicted ACL injury.

mistakes.name: Falling back
mistakes.looks: Torso upright or behind the feet on landing; you sit or step back.
mistakes.fix: Chest over your knees as you land.
mistakes.why: Distance is measured to the rear heel; balance is lost.

safety: Land on a non-slip surface; start with short jumps.
Single-leg bounds load the landing leg far more; build up slowly.
Stop when landings become loud or uneven.

variants.change: Single-leg bound sideways: push off one leg, land on the other and hold.
Repeated deep squat jumps forward, hands touch down between.
Band around the waist from behind; the jump is shorter and the take-off harder.
Broad jump, then rebound straight into a vertical jump.
Running bounds: exaggerated long strides with flight, alternating legs. Among the highest-force horizontal plyometrics.

subtypes.name: Lateral bound
subtypes.change: Push sideways off the right leg, land on the left leg and hold.

subtypes.name: Frog hops
subtypes.change: Deep squat with hands down between the feet, jump forward, land back in the deep squat.

easier: short broad jump with a stick

metrics.label: Chest over the knees on landing

motion.basis: Take-off angle from wakai2005; arm swing effect from ashby2002 and ashby2006; landing targets from padua2009 and hewett2005. Trunk here is the trunk from vertical; whole-body forward lean at take-off is about 40-50° and joint angles are estimates.
